visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair, wearing black circular glasses and a cream-colored high-neck blouse, speaks directly to the camera. Her hands gesture expressively to emphasize her points. The background is a soft beige-gold gradient featuring animated floating translucent spheres resembling oil droplets. Bright, flat studio lighting illuminates her face clearly without harsh shadows. (2) A blue-black liquid surface with ripples is shown in a close-up, featuring a '60%' text overlay. The scene cuts back to the woman gesturing with both hands while graphics appear next to her detailing ingredient names. The lighting remains consistent. Translucent white pill-shaped blobs float behind her as she continues her detailed presentation. (3) The woman applies a product around her right eye using a white tube with a metallic cooling applicator. A pink variety-style text box appears near her eye. Later, the scene transitions to a close-up of a hand rubbing white cream into skin, followed by a rose-gold hexagonal grid structure background with a glowing amber center. (4) A series of instructional graphics appear, including a green chalkboard with white text and 3D medical-style animations of a human heart and liver. The woman continues to speak in a cutaway box. Vials of liquid are displayed on a blurred shelf background. DNA helix and plant graphics also appear as she discusses scientific components. (5) The woman points towards variety-style text bubbles floating around her head containing ingredient names. She smiles and laughs towards the end of the clip. The final scene shows the brand logo 'DRX Series Skincare' centered on a white background with thin, elegant gray wavy lines across the frame.
